meta.title: Love Language Test | Discover Your Love Style - DopaBrain
meta.description: Discover your primary love language by ranking what matters most. Drag and rank 5 love language options across 8 real-life scenarios.

app.title: Love Language Test
app.subtitle: Rank what matters most to discover how you love

intro.desc: 8 scenarios · drag to rank · about 3 minutes
intro.how2: Drag the 5 options into your preferred order

quiz.rankInstruction: Drag to rank from most to least important

s1.title: After a stressful day...
s1.prompt: You've had an exhausting day. What would make you feel most loved when you get home?
s1.W: Hearing "You worked so hard today, I'm proud of you"
s1.G: Finding a small surprise gift waiting on the table
s1.A: Coming home to a warm meal already prepared
s1.T: Your partner dropping everything to sit and talk with you
s1.P: A long, warm hug the moment you walk in

s2.title: On your birthday...
s2.prompt: It's your birthday. Rank what would make it the most special.
s2.W: A heartfelt letter expressing what you mean to them
s2.G: A carefully chosen gift that shows they know you
s2.A: They plan and organize the entire day for you
s2.T: A full day spent doing your favorite things together
s2.P: Waking up to cuddles and affection all morning

s3.title: In a new relationship...
s3.prompt: You're getting to know someone new. What makes you feel the strongest connection?
s3.W: Deep conversations where they express genuine admiration
s3.G: They remember something you mentioned and surprise you with it
s3.A: They go out of their way to help you with something
s3.T: Hours fly by when you're together, no phones needed
s3.P: The electric feeling when they first hold your hand

s4.title: When you're feeling down...
s4.prompt: You're going through a tough time emotionally. What comforts you most?
s4.W: Words of reassurance: "I believe in you, you'll get through this"
s4.G: They bring you your favorite comfort treat
s4.A: They quietly take care of your responsibilities so you can rest
s4.T: They clear their schedule just to be present with you
s4.P: Being held in silence until you feel better

s5.title: On a weekend together...
s5.prompt: You have a free weekend with your partner. Rank your ideal activities.
s5.W: A long heartfelt conversation at a cozy café
s5.G: Exploring shops and picking out gifts for each other
s5.A: Working on a home project together as a team
s5.T: An unplanned adventure with phones turned off
s5.P: A lazy morning in bed, just cuddling and being close

s6.title: How you show love...
s6.prompt: When you want to show someone you care, what do you naturally do?
s6.W: Write them a message telling them how amazing they are
s6.G: Pick out a thoughtful gift that suits them perfectly
s6.A: Help them with tasks or solve a problem they have
s6.T: Make dedicated time to give them your full attention
s6.P: Give them a warm hug or comforting touch

s7.title: What hurts most when missing...
s7.prompt: In a long-distance situation, what would you miss the most?
s7.W: Hearing their voice say "I love you" and "goodnight"
s7.G: Receiving surprise care packages in the mail
s7.A: Having someone who handles things together with you
s7.T: The everyday moments of just being in the same room
s7.P: The physical closeness—hugs, hand-holding, their warmth

s8.title: The perfect anniversary...
s8.prompt: Imagine your ideal anniversary celebration. Rank what matters most.
s8.W: A toast with heartfelt words about your journey together
s8.A: Your partner secretly organized everything perfectly
s8.T: An entire evening with no distractions, just you two
s8.P: Dancing close together, holding hands all evening

desc.W: Your love language is Words of Affirmation. You feel and express love through words. Sincere compliments, heartfelt gratitude, and verbal declarations of love fill your heart like nothing else. A single meaningful sentence is worth more to you than any gift.
desc.A: Your love language is Acts of Service. You feel the deepest love when someone does things for you. Actions speak far louder than words, and when your partner goes out of their way to help you, it says 'I truly love you' more powerfully than anything.
desc.G: Your love language is Receiving Gifts. It's not about the price tag—what moves you is the heart and intention behind a gift. When your partner remembers your tastes and surprises you, you feel how truly valued you are.
desc.T: Your love language is Quality Time. To you, love means having someone's full, undivided attention. Putting down the phone, making eye contact, sharing heartfelt conversations—these everyday moments are the highest form of love.
desc.P: Your love language is Physical Touch. For you, love is felt through the skin. A hug, holding hands, or a gentle pat on the back gives you a far stronger sense of security and connection than words or gifts ever could.

advice.W: Tell your partner honestly how much their words of praise and encouragement mean to you. Simple phrases like 'thank you,' 'I love you,' and 'great job' exchanged daily can transform your relationship.
advice.A: Communicate clearly and specifically what kind of help you need—don't expect your partner to guess. When they do help, always express gratitude and let them know how much their actions feel like love to you.
advice.G: Let your partner know that gifts mean a lot to you—and that an inexpensive, heartfelt gift is just as meaningful as an expensive one. Cultivate the habit of noticing your partner's tastes and interests.
advice.T: Communicate to your partner how important undivided quality time is to you. When you're on dates, try setting a rule to minimize phone use and focus on each other.
advice.P: Talk to your partner about how much physical touch grounds and reassures you, and together find a comfort level that works for both of you.
